// Item 3 fixture (MATRICES § D, type Membre de ctx; § G, Q4). Each case is copied as a new file into a
// scanned tree of a temporary copy by tests/l0-pi-surface.test.ts.

// ── case: membre ──
export default function (api: any): void {
  api.on("turn_end", (_e: unknown, ctx: any) => ctx.membreInconnu);
}

// ── case: prefixe ──
export default function (api: any): void {
  api.on("turn_end", (_e: unknown, ctx: any) => ctx.ui.membreUiInconnu("x"));
}

// ── case: in-litteral ──
export default function (api: any): void {
  api.on("turn_end", (_e: unknown, ctx: any) => "membreSonde" in ctx);
}

// ── case: in-variable ──
const NOM_MEMBRE = "cwd";
export default function (api: any): void {
  api.on("turn_end", (_e: unknown, ctx: any) => NOM_MEMBRE in ctx);
}

// ── case: interne ──
export function epreuveInterne(ctx: { a: number }): number {
  return ctx.a + ctx.a;
}
